children.name: Evidence
children.value: Extended Content Description Object descriptor WM/EncodingSettings at 0x245 names "Lavf60.16.100"

findings.message: The Extended Content Description Object descriptor WMFSDKVersion names "Windows Media Format SDK 12.0.26100.33438", but the Extended Content Description Object descriptor WM/EncodingSettings names "FFmpeg (Lavf60.16.100)"; other software may have rewritten the file, and kept one of them.
The last superframe ends with 5703 bits after its last frame that no frame uses, since no superframe follows to finish a frame begun in them; a decoder drops them.
